title: Ideal Body Weight Methodology
overview: Ideal body weight (IBW) formulas estimate a healthy weight range based on height and sex. These formulas were originally developed for drug dosing and clinical settings, not as strict weight goals.

methods.name: Devine Formula
methods.description: Developed by Dr. B.J. Devine in 1974 for calculating medication dosages. The most widely used IBW formula in clinical settings.

formula.name: Devine (1974)
formula.expression:
Men: IBW = 50 kg + 2.3 kg × (height in inches - 60)
Women: IBW = 45.5 kg + 2.3 kg × (height in inches - 60)

methods.accuracy: Clinical standard, but not validated for actual ideal weight
limitations: Originally for drug dosing, not weight goals
methods.author: Dr. B.J. Devine

methods.name: Robinson Formula
methods.description: Modified version of Devine's formula developed by Robinson et al. in 1983 with slightly different coefficients.

formula.name: Robinson (1983)
formula.expression:
Men: IBW = 52 kg + 1.9 kg × (height in inches - 60)
Women: IBW = 49 kg + 1.7 kg × (height in inches - 60)

methods.author: Robinson et al.

methods.name: Miller Formula
methods.description: Developed by Miller et al. in 1983. Produces higher estimates than Devine for taller individuals.

formula.name: Miller (1983)
formula.expression:
Men: IBW = 56.2 kg + 1.41 kg × (height in inches - 60)
Women: IBW = 53.1 kg + 1.36 kg × (height in inches - 60)

limitations: Same fundamental limitations as other formulas
methods.author: Miller et al.

methods.name: Hamwi Formula
methods.description: Developed by Dr. G.J. Hamwi in 1964 for dietetic purposes. Popular in nutrition counseling.

formula.name: Hamwi (1964)
formula.expression:
Men: IBW = 48 kg + 2.7 kg × (height in inches - 60)
Women: IBW = 45.5 kg + 2.2 kg × (height in inches - 60)

limitations: Developed before modern research on body composition
methods.author: Dr. G.J. Hamwi

sources.name: Devine, B.J. - Drug Intelligence Clin Pharm
Peterson et al. - Ideal body weight equations comparison

footnotes: All formulas assume medium body frame
Frame size adjustment: ±10% for small/large frames
Modern approach: focus on body composition, not just weight
disclaimer: Ideal weight formulas provide rough estimates. Healthy weight depends on many factors including muscle mass, bone density, and overall health. Consult a healthcare provider for personalized guidance.
